purpose: Human-readable schema for JSON semantic contracts. Runtime validation is implemented by semantic_contracts.py.

semantic_ontology.json.description: Registry of ids. New long-lived game knowledge ids should be added here before rules reference them.

semantic_extraction_rules.json.description: Regex-driven extraction rules. Rules can either declare fact templates or use a named mechanical builder for structured captures.

semantic_relation_rules.json.description: Fact selector rules for enables, enabled_by, deck_synergy, and similar_effect behavior.

semantic_quality_policy.json.description: Audit, broadness, and web reporting policy.

template_language.$group: Reads a named regex capture group.
template_language.transform: Optional transform: int, word_number, strip, casefold, slug.
template_language.default: Value to use when a capture group is absent or empty.
template_language.$format: Formats a string with regex capture groups, for example :rb_energy_{amount}:.
template_language.$if_match_contains: Returns then/else based on whether the matched evidence contains a substring.
